انتبه إلى الخصوصية، الموافقة، سلامة المريض، وحدود الممارسة المهنية. قبل الامتحان، حاول شرح الفكرة لشخص آخر في دقيقتين، ثم اكتب ثلاثة مصطلحات أساسية وسؤالًا تطبيقيًا واحدًا وإجابة مختصرة عليه.

Typical methods include problem definition, modeling, calculation, design comparison, testing, validation, and interpretation of technical data.

## Practical skills
Build competence through repeated application rather than passive reading. Important skills include quantitative reasoning, technical drawing or modeling, measurement, troubleshooting, documentation, and safe design practice. After each exercise, note what worked, what failed, and what you would change next time.

## Exam preparation
Prioritize core principles, units and assumptions, worked calculations, design trade-offs, and interpretation of diagrams or technical cases. Practice short explanations in your own words, then test yourself with a scenario that requires application rather than recall.

## Quick self-check
- Can I define the central terms accurately without notes?
- Can I explain how the major ideas relate to one another?
- Can I choose an appropriate method for a simple problem and justify it?
- Can I identify a common error, limitation, or safety issue?
- Can I apply the idea to a new academic or professional example?
